query: Show me the samples I own on Flow.
expected_behavior: Recognises the request is caller-scoped (needs `owned=true`) and therefore requires authentication.
Detects that no usable token is available — `flow-cli api get /me --json` fails with 401 (exit 3), or there is no `~/.config/flow/api-token` file.
Does NOT report a result from an anonymous `owned=true` query, which the API silently filters to `owner=NULL` and would return a plausible-but-wrong answer.

Tells the user how to authenticate: create an API key in the Flow web app (Settings -> Account Management -> API Keys, purpose 'AI Agent') and save it to `~/.config/flow/api-token`, or set `FLOW_API_TOKEN`. Links the full steps at https://github.com/goodwright/flow-skills/blob/main/plugins/flowbio/README.md#getting-a-flow-api-key-optional.
Preserves token discipline and does not fabricate a token, a count, or a sample list.
